scripts.test:release: node --test scripts/test/*.test.mjs && node --test artifacts/api-server/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/airank test
scripts.build:release: pnpm run typecheck && PORT=5000 BASE_PATH=/ pnpm --filter @workspace/airank run build && pnpm --filter @workspace/api-server run build
scripts.lint: prettier --check docs/API-CONTRACT.md docs/ARCHITECTURE-DECISIONS.md docs/BATCH-01-AUDIT.md docs/DEPLOYMENT.md docs/FIGMA-MAP.md docs/IMPLEMENTATION-STATUS.md docs/METHODOLOGY.md scripts/audit-baseline.mjs
scripts.test: node scripts/audit-baseline.mjs && node --test services/bunny-api/test/*.test.mjs && node --test artifacts/api-server/test/*.test.mjs && pnpm --filter @workspace/airank test
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.build: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm -r --if-present run build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
